Sanitized Word-export parser fixture: four PublicKeyToken fields in customXml/item4.xml identify public .NET assemblies, not authentication credentials. Creator/editor metadata and non-citation external URLs are synthetic; licensed government-policy citations retain their original targets. All 49 package parts and OOXML producer metadata, relationships and import structure are retained; no media or thumbnail parts exist.

Synthetic GitHub issue URL acme/project exercises inferSource provider and remoteId parsing, actor-bound PKCE refusal, single-use OAuth state rejection and encrypted credential non-disclosure; fetch is mocked in this test.

Synthetic test/repo issue URLs bind the mocked GitHub transport to exact targets; tests reject revoked grants and source authority changes and prevent duplicate dispatch after uncertain responses. No real repository or provider request is used.

Synthetic test/repo GitHub issue URL is the shared mocked provider fixture for current-grant authority/revocation and inquiry-custody tests; exact target matching rejects unmatched transport. No real repository or provider request is used.

Synthetic canary/private GitHub API URL exercises actual outbound transport rejection and verifies that canary request values reach only the declared provider family through the test boundary recorder. The fixture has no real repository or owner account. Assertions verify all six destinations and provider failures.
